candidate_generation: generate/freeze all arms and cases BEFORE running any candidate validator
freshness_scope: projects never used in earlier Genesis G11 or G12 independent and development runs; public Defects4J bugs are not guaranteed unseen by foundation models
frozen_policy_source: V2.1 genesis.v2.semantic_dsl + genesis.repair_strategist and default V1, no post-selection edits
not_claimed: proof of general RSI or statistically powered comparison
selection_rule: int(sha256(seed),16) modulo active-bugs.csv row count, fixed project roster before inspection
source_selection: bounded 24 dynamically loaded .java classes ranked by public failing test class/source evidence, identical for both arms
tooling: buggy revision only; no fixed version, human reference patches, hidden answers, issue descriptions or training from evaluation outcome before freeze
validation: compile candidate; run public original failing triggers; full Defects4J suite required if triggers pass; zero failures+exit0
